faqs: Do I need to know about computers to use Webify?
No. Every page uses big buttons and plain words. If you get stuck, press the blue Help button at the bottom of the screen. It tells you what to do on that page.
Designs start at ₱299 and you only pay once. Creators set their own hourly rates, which you can see on their profile before you message them.
A template is a ready-made design. Think of it as a ready-to-wear dress that only needs small adjustments: you add your business name, photos, and prices, and it is ready.
How do I know a creator can be trusted?
Look for the blue Verified badge. It means Webify has checked that person's identity and past work. You can also read their ratings and see their portfolio.
Can a person help me set everything up?
Yes. Choose Creators to hire someone, or choose Get Advice to book a session with a business adviser.
Can I make the words on the screen bigger?
Yes. Press the blue Help button at the bottom of the screen, then press "Change text size and colors". Your choice is remembered the next time you visit.

boundaries.title: Shipping and warehousing
boundaries.text: We help you set up your website and license designs. We do not store your products, track inventory, or deliver orders.

boundaries.title: Custom apps and large software
boundaries.text: We work with templates and standard website changes. Building a custom iPhone or Android app or large company software is outside what we offer.

boundaries.title: Legal, tax, and audit work
boundaries.text: Our advisers give practical business and digital guidance. They do not act as your lawyer, file your taxes, or audit your books.

home.title: Using the Home page
steps: Read the big cards under "What would you like to do today?"
Press the card for what you want to do.
Not sure? Press "Start the Business Check" for a suggestion.

templates.title: Finding a design
steps: Choose your type of business from the list, or type a word in the search box.
Press "Preview" to see the design up close, on a computer or a phone.
Press "Add to Cart" when you like one. Then press the Cart button at the top to finish.

creators.title: Finding a creator
steps: Type what you need, or press a skill button such as "Graphic Designer".
Press "View Profile" to see their past work and rating.
Press "Send Message" to talk to them. Saying hello is free.

messages.title: Sending a message
steps: Choose a person from the list.
Type your message in the box at the bottom, or press one of the ready-made messages.
Press the "Send" button. Their answer appears on this page.

advice.title: Booking an adviser
steps: Pick the topic you need help with.
Pick an adviser, then pick a day and a time.
Type your name and contact details, then press "Confirm Booking". You will see it under My Projects.

check.title: Taking the Business Check
steps: Read each question and press the answer closest to your situation.
Use the "Go Back" button if you want to change an answer.
At the end you will get a score and clear suggestions on what to do next.

projects.title: Using My Projects
steps: See every project and how far along it is.
When a creator sends work, press "Approve" if you like it, or "Ask for Changes" if you do not.
Press "Appointments" to see adviser sessions you have booked.

default.title: Finding your way
steps: Use the menu to move between pages.
Press the Webify logo at any time to return to the Home page.
Use your browser's back button to return to the last page.
